name: Loudoun County, Virginia (United States)
description: Banner of the county arms: gyronny of eight red and ermine, within a green embattled border strewn with white drops for milk.
history: Loudoun County is a county in Northern Virginia. The flag is a banner of the arms devised for the county by the English College of Arms in 1968, based on the arms of the 4th Earl of Loudoun, colonial governor of Virginia; the green border stands for agriculture and the white drops for the dairy industry.
